A '''micrometer'''<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref> or '''micron'''<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> was a unit of measurement. The [[Model-1 "Nova Viper" blaster pistol/Legends|Model-1 "Nova Viper" blaster pistol]] was tooled down to a fraction of a micrometer.<ref name="Fly" /> The fine [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulator arm]] of an [[R5-series astromech droid]] could accurately place objects with degree of error less than one micrometer.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
